title: Ticket workflow labels
summary: Ticket status and priority now read as Title Case labels on every ticket screen and in ticket update emails.
changes: Ticket lists and details show statuses such as In Progress and priorities such as Urgent instead of stored values.
Ticket create and staff edit selects show Title Case labels while keeping the same stored values.
Ticket update emails show the Title Case status and priority.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: display labels only, with no data, validation or permission change.
validation: TicketWorkflowLabelsTest covers lists, details, selects and the update email.
PublicTicketPriorityTest confirms option values are unchanged.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Ticket service area names are unchanged in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
